entries.english:
St. Mary’s — renovation of the swallow’s nest organ

Photographs of the benefit event; centenary anniversary program of the Lippe Local Heritage Association.
Newspaper clippings (copied); correspondence; benefit evening program; Charles Brauer reads Kämpfer texts; benefit event for the restoration of St. Nicolai (see cross-reference), restoration of the swallow’s nest organ; event liability insurance; invitation to the benefit event; invoice from Norbert Giebel music shop, concert tuning of the Steinway; coverage in Lippe Aktuell; use of the Educational Center at Bürgermeister-Gräfer Secondary School; biography of Latica Honda-Rosenberg; press correspondence about coverage, including Die Zeit, Schaumburger Nachrichten, and Westfalen-Blatt.
